Progress '1 of 3' → '2 of 3' → '3 of 3 ingredients collected'; ✓ rows; 'Modified' tag on C4LL.
'Mix complete — ready for mixer' → 'Mix complete?' → Confirm → confirm success 534 ms; 'Ingredients confirmed. Scan a permitted mixer…'.
(part) Non-machine codes DOL-MIX-01, MIX-01 etc. → '✕ Not a machine — X'. Extruder-as-mixer not tested (codes unknown).
Home ignores RFID + barcode (no wire); Login RFID → badge; Lookup badge → refusal; Prep barcodes → identify/machine.
Jobs on Station 2: 510023052, 067, 069, 085, 102, 106 after lookups. Usability: list is a nested scroll box showing ~2 rows; easy to miss entries.
510023069 Prepare: 'This job already has 1 active preparation(s). Open one to continue it — Prepare creates a new allocation.' with the PREP listed.

510023069: 'Choose Include or Exclude for 1500000306', neither preselected; Exclude → confirm 'Job 510023069. Excluded: 1500000306.'; payload ingredientChoices [{code 1500000306, include:false}]; PREP_…7d666c shows PW60 'excluded · Modified'.

'▸ Exceptions (1)' expands: 'Ingredient omitted · Excluded · 1500000306 … target 3 → 0 kg'. Minor: shows 'operator e33f…' instead of operator name.
'Main extruder 1 is an extruder — scan a mixer'; at produce step 'Main mixer 1 is a mixer — scan an extruder'; non-machine codes → 'Not a machine — X'.

Scan 'Main mixer 2' while mixing → '✕ Only Main mixer 1 can finish this mix'.
Finish mix 1 → machine_finish with cycleId CYC_8ab86dfa542f4a40b05b9f6abe8763db, success 308 ms → 'All 1 mix mixed'.
'Free extruders: Main extruder 1 … (25)'; Main extruder 1 → 'Start production 1' → 'Producing 1 of 1'.

9 of 11 mixers mixing simultaneously (DOLCI mixer 1/2, Main mixer 1–5, Mackie, Bubblewrap); Station 2 list showed all 'in use'. DOLCI, Mackie, Bubblewrap are fixed pairs (no Produce step).

'Main mixer 6' and 'Crespi Mixer' are listed as free mixers but scanning their exact names → 'Not a machine — X'. Machine code ≠ display name for these two (all others: code = name). Need codes / data fix.

Max load: JC 510022145 had 27 active PREPs at once — 25 Producing (Main extruder 1–25, one each) + 2 Mixing (DOLCI mixer 1/2). All machine_start / machine_finish success; one 'Station 2 did not respond' during the last start (backend restart), succeeded on retry. All 27 finished → 29 of 66 finished.

A prepare got no reply (backend restart); Job Detail showed 'A prepare for this job is waiting for Station 2 — Open' and blocked new prepares; Open re-sent the original → success → exactly one PREP (…e6a69e).
Prepare screen lists every active PREP above the mix-count form; with 10+ active PREPs the form and Prepare button are far below the fold.

All 189 JCs looked up (see Job Coverage): 158/160 qualified loaded (510023047/050 Rajoo-claimed, refused correctly), 9/9 no-whole-mix refused, 13/20 unavailable now load, 7 refused with readable reasons. 3 transient timeouts retried OK.

'Good afternoon, Avi/Jono' after 12:00; Job Cards and Rajoo tiles open the right screens.

SAP posting enabled per guide; user approved running finish tests ('Run all tests').
